description: A tested reference reads its projected original sound. a="a" holds of the chosen a, whose reconstructed span also holds the synthetic T="ta". c reads that synthetic with a terminal test, which reads the saved sound (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a="a" | b | c
%rule a A [T="ta"]
%rule b A [T] [T]
%rule c A T="ta"
